## Deploy readiness board (R100, informational)

This check is informational on pull requests during the pre-launch
burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,
env discovery, operator keys) are surfaced below but do not block the
PR because the runner carries no production secrets. The prod-deploy
gate (deploy-readiness-gate) enforces every section under strict mode.


OPENING (B-CM5-119, agent 119) — growth-project-backend#703 @ d60a6d58a577fb90fdd7b78463971c8617b30224

**What this PR is**
- Split M5 of #641. It holds only the tests for coach Money FIX ROUND 4.
- Base: #677's branch.
- Size: **+460/-0 = 460** changed lines, under the 1,500 limit for new PRs (operator rule, 12:33 PDT 10-04).
- It is tests only and makes no runtime change. It lands with the stack (rule 11).

**Why it exists:** #674 (2,975), #676 (2,984) and #677 (2,918) have no room under their 3,000 ceiling.

**Specs**
- `test/refund-reversal-send-time.spec.ts`, 9 cases, for #674 B-674-13 and B-674-14:
  - Send-time admission over a long run.
  - A window crossed by 1 s between selection and send.
  - An in-window control with the send-time attempt stamp.
  - A paging control.
  - A `has_more` empty page.
  - A page that makes no progress.
  - Owner reconcile answering a closed 503 `TRANSFER_REVERSALS_LIST_INCOMPLETE`.
  - Complete two-page and complete-empty controls.
- `test/refund-reversal-first-pass.spec.ts`, 2 cases, for #674 C-674-12:
  - When overlapping deliveries race and the delivery without the ledger claim wins the record 1 ms later, every posting still carries the refund's posted_at.
  - Control: a redelivery 2 h after a failed first attempt posts the head share at that later time.
- `test/coach-money-billed-mrr.spec.ts`, 6 cases, for #676 B-676-5:
  - A trial whose first invoice fails, written by the real webhook writer, counts as neither MRR nor paying.
  - Controls: a billed past_due renewal, a first paid conversion, an active trial, a canceled never-billed purchase, and a client with both a billed and a never-billed purchase.
  - The exported `BILLED_WHERE`.

**Failing before (CI lane, no fix)**
- [run 37229228865](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37229228865): send-time spec 6/9 red by assertion; the 3 controls are green.
- [run 37230310550](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37230310550): first-pass race case red; its control is green.
- [run 37229475145](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37229475145): billed-MRR spec 4/6 red by assertion; the conversion and active-trial controls are green.

**After (all green)**
- [run 37230321895](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37230321895) at #674 8cc17809
- [run 37230404105](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37230404105) at #676 ecaf75fd
- This PR's own CI runs all three in build-and-test.

**Head history:** 73fa700c was the first push (355 lines), before C-674-12 was added. d60a6d58 merges #677 6340993b; its tree equals `git merge-tree`. It also adds the first-pass spec.

**Checks at this head:** all applicable checks green: build-and-test, rls-floor-guard, rls-live-tests, mwb-3-live-tests, npm audit, Schema parity, community-live-tests ([CI run 37230364653](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37230364653)); deploy-readiness-gate skips by design. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only on main-based PRs (stacked base): they ran green on the #674 base at 8cc17809 and run again when the composed train targets main.

READY FOR AUDIT
